about.title: About
about.body: A group of NHL Stenden students started HelloLWD in the summer of 2026. We share the city's news, events and the nights you don't forget.
about.more: Summaries only, for internationals in Leeuwarden. Every story links back to its source. We read public RSS from Omrop Fryslân, Omroep Leeuwarden, LC.nl and NOS, show the Leeuwarden weather from Open-Meteo, and keep a weekend list. No accounts, no comments, no full-article copies.
about.guideCta: First month in Leeuwarden: BSN, DigiD, bins

guide.title: Your first month
guide.intro: Three things the Dutch sites bury in long forms. Register first. Then DigiD. Then the bins.
guide.bsn: Stay longer than four months? Book a gemeente appointment within five days of arriving. You register in the BRP and leave with a Burgerservicenummer. NHL Stenden often emails students a booking link. No walk-in. Town hall is Oldehoofsterkerkhof 2. Bring a passport and proof of your Leeuwarden address. Call 14058. Staying under four months is RNI, not BRP. That can still be Leeuwarden, but from 2026 a non-EU passport has to go to Breda or Venlo.
guide.digid: DigiD is the login for tax, healthcare, DUO and most government sites. You need the BSN first. Apply at digid.nl. The activation letter goes to your registered address, so wait until the gemeente has your street.
guide.waste: Leeuwarden waste is Omrin, not Afvalwijzer. Put your postcode in their calendar. The Omrin app reminds you. In the centre, restafval is often underground; you need a milieupas after you are registered at the address. The gemeente page lists GFT, paper and PMD.
guide.note: HelloLWD is a student news desk, not the gemeente. Rules change. If a page here disagrees with Leeuwarden.nl or Omrin, trust them.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.who: HelloLWD is a local news and weekend briefing started by NHL Stenden students in Leeuwarden, the Netherlands. Contact: info@hellolwd.com.
privacy.data:
We do not run user accounts, comments, newsletters or ads. We do not sell data.

On our server we store public RSS items (headline, short summary, source link, photo URL, category) and curated weekend events so the site can show them. Your browser does not send us a visitor profile. If you email us, we only keep what you wrote so we can reply.
privacy.cookies: Language lives in the URL (/nl, /en, /es, /fa), not in a tracking cookie. Light or dark theme is stored in localStorage and in a first-party cookie named theme (one year) so the page does not flash. The admin desk sets a first-party cookie named hellolwd_admin after login; that cookie is only for people who edit the site.
privacy.third:
News comes from the public RSS of Omrop Fryslân, Omroep Leeuwarden, LC.nl and NOS. We always link back to the original article.

Weather for Leeuwarden is fetched on our server from Open-Meteo. SC Cambuur scores and the Eredivisie table are fetched on our server from ESPN. Translations may be made on our server with Google AI Studio (Gemini) and, if that quota is empty, other machine-translation services. Those requests leave our server. They are not sent from your browser.
privacy.rights: If you think we hold personal data about you, you can ask for access, correction or deletion at info@hellolwd.com. You can complain to the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.needed: HelloLWD uses a few first-party cookies to keep the site working. We do not use advertising, analytics or social-media tracking cookies, so we do not show a marketing-consent banner.
cookies.list:
theme — first-party, functional, one year. Remembers light or dark.

hellolwd_admin — first-party, functional, only after an editor logs in at /admin. Not set for ordinary readers.

Language is not a cookie: it is the first part of the address (/fa, /en, /nl, /es).
cookies.notused: No Google Analytics, no ad pixels, no fingerprinting. Weather and news feeds are loaded on the server, so Open-Meteo and the newsrooms do not drop cookies in your browser through this site.
cookies.choice: You can clear cookies and site data in your browser. That resets the theme and signs an editor out of the desk. Questions: info@hellolwd.com.
